English: PIXL re-array Generator for Shimadzu MALDI-TOF
The path should match this pattern: ...Tracking\[date]\Colony Detection\[project name]
Select target adapter used to house Shimadzu targets in PIXL:
The adapter can hold up to 4 Shimadzu targets (Target 1 to 4, left to right). Select the first Shimadzu target and the position to start pinning to. Subsequent targets will be filled from A1.
By default, reagents (formic acid and matrix) are held in a 96 MWP. To change the reagents plate type, please select one of the available templates:
Enter the well position of a 96 multiwell plate that contains formic acid. This will be the same multiwell plate that contains matrix [if matrix addition is enabled].
Please select whether PIXL should pin formic acid once (Single Dip) or twice (Double Dip) onto the microbial material.
Enter the well position of a 96 multwell plate that contains matrix. This will be the same multwell plate that contains formic acid [if formic acid addition is enabled].
Please select whether PIXL should pin matrix once (Single Dip) or twice (Double Dip) onto the microbial material.
Select Start Position for first target plate. Once the first target plate has been filled, addtional target plates will fill from A1:
